## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 189 captures during May 2020. This activity provides the basis for the site’s image quality and grading results for the reporting period. The recorded volume is presented as the total activity for the clinic during the month.

## Image quality

Of the 189 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.6 per cent. This result identifies the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and should be considered alongside the total activity recorded for May 2020.

The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Maintaining a record of these issues will support follow-up on image quality concerns and help keep the operational record complete.

## Grading

Grading identified 37 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This provides the reported measure of the time between the image being captured and the grading outcome being recorded.
